subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Withdraw
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3' **i.e. **'Retreat'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **"Withdraw".** Withdraw **means** to remove or take away something from a particular place or situation.(वापस लेना)
 
• **Retreat: **Retreat has a similar meaning to withdraw, as it also implies moving back or away from a situation or place, often due to danger or fear. (हट जाना)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Retreat'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Explanation of other options:
 
 
• **Engage: **Engage means to participate or become involved in a particular situation or task.(सक्रिय होना)
 
• **Persevere: **Persevere means to continue in a course of action even in the face of difficulty or with little or no prospect of success.(दृढ़ संकल्प)
 
• **Combine:** Combine means to unite for a common purpose or to join together.(मिलाना)
